name: Azure Key Vault
summary: Azure Key Vault stores and manages encryption keys, secrets and certificates for Azure services and applications. Every vault is encrypted at rest with keys held in hardware security modules, and access is controlled through Azure role-based access control or vault access policies. Microsoft publishes no price: its pricing page lists billing units with no amounts, so both tiers are shown as quote only.

facts.text: The overview says Key Vault can be used as a key management solution, and that it makes it easy to create and control the encryption keys used to encrypt your data.
The overview says all key vaults are encrypted at rest using keys stored in hardware security modules.
The overview says authorization may be done through Azure role-based access control or a Key Vault access policy, and that authentication is done through Microsoft Entra ID.
The overview says the Standard tier uses software cryptographic modules validated to FIPS 140 Level 1, and the Premium tier protects keys in HSMs validated to FIPS 140-3 Level 3.

According to the vendor's pricing page, prices are calculated in US dollars, but no amount is filled in. Secrets and software-protected keys are billed per 10,000 transactions, and HSM-protected keys are charged per key per month, in the Premium tier only.

plans.name: Standard tier
plans.unit: per 10,000 transactions for secrets and software-protected keys, plus per scheduled key rotation
plans.notes: The vendor publishes no price. The pricing page lists billing units and no amount.

plans.name: Premium tier
plans.unit: per HSM-protected key per month, plus per 10,000 transactions
plans.notes: The vendor publishes no price. The pricing page lists billing units and no amount. Standard shows no HSM-protected key charge.

hiddenCosts: The vendor publishes no price. The pricing page shows billing units for each tier with no amount filled in.
Managed HSM pools have an hourly usage fee per pool, listed without an amount.
Certificate renewals are billed per renewal request, with no amount shown.
